name: HasDistribNeg.toInvolutiveNeg
typeText: {α : Type u_1} → {inst : Mul.{u_1} α} → [self : HasDistribNeg.{u_1} α] → InvolutiveNeg.{u_1} α

source.code:
class HasDistribNeg (α : Type*) [Mul α] extends InvolutiveNeg α where
  /-- Negation is left distributive over multiplication -/
  neg_mul : ∀ x y : α, -x * y = -(x * y)
  /-- Negation is right distributive over multiplication -/
  mul_neg : ∀ x y : α, x * -y = -(x * y)
